title: Neon Tetra care guide
summary: A peaceful schooling fish for mature community aquariums.
body: Keep at least eight and plan swimming room for the adult group, not the shop-sized juveniles. Use mature, stable water and leave an open swimming run.
seo_title: Neon Tetra care and tank mates
seo_description: Tank size, water range, group size and temperament for Neon Tetra.

title: 霓虹灯饲养指南
summary: 适合成熟社区缸的温和群游鱼。
body: 至少八尾群养，按成鱼群体而非店内幼鱼规划空间。使用成熟稳定的水体，并保留连续游泳空间。
seo_title: 霓虹灯饲养与混养
seo_description: 查看霓虹灯的缸体、水质、群养和性情建议。

title: Ember Tetra care guide
summary: A tiny, warm-water schooling fish with a calm temperament.
body: Keep at least eight in planted cover with gentle flow. Small individual size does not remove the need for enough space for the adult group.
seo_title: Ember Tetra care and tank mates
seo_description: Tank size, water range, group size and temperament for Ember Tetra.

title: 火焰灯饲养指南
summary: 体型小、性情温和的暖水群游鱼。
body: 至少八尾群养，提供水草遮蔽和缓水流。单尾体型小，也需要为成鱼群体保留足够空间。
seo_title: 火焰灯饲养与混养
seo_description: 查看火焰灯的缸体、水质、群养和性情建议。

title: Harlequin Rasbora care guide
summary: A hardy mid-water schooling fish for peaceful community tanks.
body: Keep at least eight with cover and a clear swimming run. Size the aquarium for the adult group rather than the number of small fish sold together.
seo_title: Harlequin Rasbora care and tank mates
seo_description: Tank size, water range, group size and temperament for Harlequin Rasbora.

title: 三角灯饲养指南
summary: 适合温和社区缸的耐养中层群游鱼。
body: 至少八尾群养，提供遮蔽和连续游泳空间。按成年群体规划缸体，不能以店内幼鱼装得下为标准。
seo_title: 三角灯饲养与混养
seo_description: 查看三角灯的缸体、水质、群养和性情建议。

title: Honey Gourami care guide
summary: A gentle labyrinth fish that often explores the upper half of the tank.
body: Keep calm tank mates and surface cover; avoid strong surface flow.
seo_title: Honey Gourami care and tank mates
seo_description: Tank size, water range, group size and temperament for Honey Gourami.

title: 蜜丽丽饲养指南
summary: 性情温和、常活动于上层的迷鳃鱼。
body: 建议搭配安静的混养鱼，并保留水面遮蔽物，避免强水流。
seo_title: 蜜丽丽饲养与混养
seo_description: 查看蜜丽丽的缸体、水质、群养和性情建议。

title: Panda Corydoras care guide
summary: A social bottom-dweller that spends much of its time sifting the substrate.
body: Keep a group on smooth substrate and feed a suitable sinking food. Leftover food and algae alone do not meet their needs; they are not a substitute for cleaning.
seo_title: Panda Corydoras care and tank mates
seo_description: Tank size, water range, group size and temperament for Panda Corydoras.

title: 熊猫鼠饲养指南
summary: 喜欢群居、主要活动在底层的底栖鱼。
body: 使用圆润底材并保持足够群体，专门投喂合适的沉底食物。残饵和藻类不能满足它们的需要，鼠鱼也不能代替清洁。
seo_title: 熊猫鼠饲养与混养
seo_description: 查看熊猫鼠的缸体、水质、群养和性情建议。

title: Red Cherry Shrimp care guide
summary: A small freshwater shrimp that grazes on surfaces and biofilm.
body: Provide cover, stable water and a mature grazing surface. Guard filter intakes with shrimp-safe sponge or mesh, especially for juveniles; many fish will eat shrimplets.
seo_title: Red Cherry Shrimp care and tank mates
seo_description: Tank size, water range, group size and compatibility notes for Red Cherry Shrimp.

title: 樱花虾饲养指南
summary: 会在缸体表面和生物膜上取食的小型淡水虾。
body: 提供躲避处、稳定水质和成熟取食表面。过滤进水口加防虾海绵或细网，尤其保护幼虾；许多鱼会捕食幼虾。
seo_title: 樱花虾饲养与混养
seo_description: 查看樱花虾的缸体、水质、群养和混养注意事项。

title: Guppy care guide
summary: A small livebearer with many colour strains and frequent broods.
body: Plan for adult females and their fry. Separating males and females helps control numbers, but previously mated females can still produce later broods; keep a rehoming plan.
seo_title: Guppy care and tank planning
seo_description: A small livebearer with many colour strains and frequent broods.

title: 孔雀鱼饲养指南
summary: 色彩品系丰富、繁殖速度较快的小型胎生鱼。
body: 按成鱼和后代的空间规划数量。公母分养有助于控制繁殖，但已交配的母鱼仍可能连续产仔，提前安排幼鱼去向。
seo_title: 孔雀鱼饲养与缸体规划
seo_description: 色彩品系丰富、繁殖速度较快的小型胎生鱼。

title: Siamese Fighting Fish care guide
summary: A warm-water labyrinth fish usually best planned as a single male.
body: Keep males separately. Use a secure lid with an air gap, gentle flow and resting places near the surface; assess tank mates individually.
seo_title: Siamese Fighting Fish care and tank planning
seo_description: A warm-water labyrinth fish usually best planned as a single male.

title: 暹罗斗鱼饲养指南
summary: 适合以单尾雄鱼规划饲养的暖水迷鳃鱼。
body: 雄鱼分开饲养。使用留有空气层的牢固缸盖，保持缓水流，并在近水面提供休息点；混养需逐一评估。
seo_title: 暹罗斗鱼饲养与缸体规划
seo_description: 适合以单尾雄鱼规划饲养的暖水迷鳃鱼。

title: Zebra Danio care guide
summary: An active, striped schooling fish that needs a long swimming run.
body: Keep at least six and prioritise a tank about 60 cm long or longer over height alone. Secure the lid: these quick swimmers can jump.
seo_title: Zebra Danio care and tank planning
seo_description: An active, striped schooling fish that needs a long swimming run.

title: 斑马鱼饲养指南
summary: 游动活跃、需要连续游泳空间的条纹群游鱼。
body: 至少六尾群养，优先选择约60厘米或更长的缸体，不能只看高度或升数。它们游动快，也会跳缸，应加盖。
seo_title: 斑马鱼饲养与缸体规划
seo_description: 游动活跃、需要连续游泳空间的条纹群游鱼。

title: Bristlenose Pleco care guide
summary: A bottom-dwelling Ancistrus form whose adult size and waste need planning.
body: Common shop forms vary in exact identity. Provide hiding places and aquarium-safe wood, sinking food with a plant component and small portions of vegetables; remove leftovers. It produces waste and cannot replace maintenance.
seo_title: Bristlenose Pleco care and tank planning
seo_description: A bottom-dwelling Ancistrus form whose adult size and waste need planning.

title: 胡子异型饲养指南
summary: 需要按成体尺寸和排泄负担规划的底栖胡子异型。
body: 常见商品品系的准确种名可能不同。提供躲避处和适用沉木，投喂含植物成分的沉底饲料及少量蔬菜，及时取出残饵；排泄量需考虑，不能代替清洁维护。
seo_title: 胡子异型饲养与缸体规划
seo_description: 需要按成体尺寸和排泄负担规划的底栖胡子异型。
